data.name: Mehroo
data.gender_notes: Mehroo is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehroo is a Persian name that signifies a close friend or companion. It is a term of endearment in Islamic tradition. The name Mehroo carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehroo usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Mehroo represents the bond of brotherhood and sisterhood in faith.
data.etymology: Mehroo belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehroo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
